blocks.raw: # Cloudlets Documentation
blocks.text: Cloudlets Documentation

blocks.raw: > Akamai's Cloudlets are value-added applications that complement Akamai’s core delivery solutions to solve specific business challenges. Cloudlets bring a site’s business logic closer to the end user by placing it on the edge of the content delivery platform.
